meta.title: Create and publish a Knockout auction
gaps: Configure the converted auction as Knockout, choose the offer entity, enter Starting Price, Tick Size, and time difference between consecutive offers, then save and publish the converted auction
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the converted auction as Knockout, choose the offer entity, enter Starting Price, Tick Size, and time difference between consecutive offers, then save and publish the converted auction

steps.note: Create an RFQ first because Knockout auctions are only reachable through RFQ-to-Auction conversion.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the required auction line item.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Publish the source RFQ needed for conversion.
Verify the source RFQ became a published event.
Open the converted-auction create screen, the supported route to Knockout configuration.

Check that upcoming offers are shown.
